# Sirach Chapter 43 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 43 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**43:1** The pride of the heights above is the clear vault of heaven; the appearance of the sky is a vision of glory.

**43:2** The sun, when it appears, makes proclamation as it rises — a marvelous creation, the work of the Most High.

**43:3** At midday it parches the land; and who can endure its scorching heat?

**43:4** A man tending a furnace labors in the heat, but the sun scorches the mountains three times more; breathing out fiery vapors and shooting out blinding rays, it dazzles the eyes.

**43:5** Great is the Lord who made it; and at his word it runs swiftly on its course.

**43:6** The moon also marks the passage of time in all its phases; it is a sign of seasons and an everlasting symbol.

**43:7** From the moon comes the reckoning of feast days, a light that wanes when it has reached its full.

**43:8** The month is called after its name, increasing marvelously as it changes; it is an instrument of the host on high, shining brilliantly in the firmament of heaven.

**43:9** The brilliance of the stars is the glory of the skies; a sparkling adornment in the heights of the Lord.

**43:10** At the command of the Holy One they stand in due order, and they never slacken at their watch.

**43:11** Look at the rainbow and praise its Maker; it shines with a surpassing loveliness.

**43:12** It arches across the sky with a radiant bow, drawn by the hands of the Most High.

**43:13** By his command he sends driving snow, and hurls down flashes of his judgment.

**43:14** Therefore the storehouses are opened, and the clouds fly out like birds.

**43:15** In his majesty he densifies the clouds, and the hailstones are broken into pieces.

**43:16** The voice of his thunder makes the earth quake; the tempest of the north and the whirlwind.

**43:17** Like birds alighting, he scatters the snowflakes; they settle like a swarm of locusts descending.

**43:18** The eye marvels at the beauty of their whiteness, and the heart is struck by the wonder of their falling.

**43:19** He also pours out frost upon the earth like salt; when it freezes it becomes bristling points of ice.

**43:20** The cold north wind blows and ice forms over the water; it settles on every pool, and the water is sheathed as if in armor.

**43:21** It consumes the mountains and scorches the wilderness; it burns fresh green grass like fire.

**43:22** But a sudden mist brings healing to all; dew falling after heat brings relief.

**43:23** By his counsel he has stilled the ocean deep and planted islands in it.

**43:24** Those who sail the sea tell of its dangers; we listen to them with astonishment.

**43:25** For in it are his most astonishing works, all manner of strange and varied creatures, the whole teeming world of living things and the great sea monsters.

**43:26** Because of him his messenger succeeds; and by his word all things cohere.

**43:27** We could say more, and still never say enough; the final word is: He is the all.

**43:28** Where shall we find the strength to praise him? For he is greater than all his works.

**43:29** The Lord is awesome and exceedingly great, and his power is wonderful.

**43:30** Exalt the Lord as highly as you can, for still he surpasses you. When you exalt him, gather all your strength; do not grow weary, for you cannot come to the end.

**43:31** Who has seen him and can describe him? Who can praise him as he truly is?

**43:32** Many things greater than these remain hidden; we have seen but a few of his works.

**43:33** For the Lord made all things, and to the devout he has given wisdom.
